title: NASA Mars 2020 Perseverance Geolocated Science Observation Targets
description: Authentic science observation targets with instrument citations, discovery sols, and coordinates for route planning integration.

targets.name: Wildcat Ridge Organic Mudstone
targets.discovery_summary: Aromatics, sulfate minerals, and organic carbonaceous molecules detected via deep-UV resonance Raman spectroscopy in finely laminated sulfate-rich mudstone.
targets.pds_citation: Scheller et al. (2022), Science 378, 1105-1110; NASA PDS SHERLOC Archive

targets.name: Skinner Ridge Deltaic Sandstone
targets.discovery_summary: Sub-millimeter elemental X-ray fluorescence mapping revealed detrital clay and carbonate grains transported by ancient fluvial delta channels.
targets.pds_citation: Farley et al. (2022), Science 377; NASA PDS PIXL Archive

targets.name: Enchanted Lake Delta Bottomset
targets.discovery_summary: Fine-grained laminated bottomset beds showing clay mineral enrichment consistent with quiet-water lacustrine deposition.
targets.pds_citation: Mangold et al. (2021), Science 374; NASA PDS SuperCam Archive

targets.name: Kodiak Delta Outlier Butte
targets.discovery_summary: Classic Gilbert-type delta foreset-topset architecture confirming an ancient lake fed by a sustained river system in Jezero Crater.

targets.name: Belva Crater Impact Ejecta Overlook
targets.discovery_summary: Subsurface radar sounding (RIMFAX) and visual panorama of deep Jezero stratigraphy excavated by post-delta impact event.
targets.pds_citation: Hamran et al. (2022), Science Advances 8; NASA PDS RIMFAX Node
